pin.estimand: Fresh recertification token_delta: least-favourable maximum equal-item mean across cl100k_base and o200k_base under tiktoken 0.14.0 on 16 balanced full-mapping pairs.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains ratified and its recertification card remains live immediately before mint.
All 16 complete pairs are unique and exactly absent from every served prior test_set.
The carrier has four items per endpoint state and includes descending written-order controls.
Every English arm explicitly states both endpoint-membership facts and every Ainglish arm preserves the instruction with the matching registered qualifier.
The tokenizer roster and tiktoken 0.14.0 are pinned; tiktoken is imported only after mint.
Every finite result is retained and filed once without tuning or retry.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before this process imports tiktoken or observes a count.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair on cl100k_base and o200k_base. Average all 16 items equally per tokenizer; report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least savings, with value_lo/value_hi as the member span. Marker strata are diagnostic.
manifest.population: 16 fresh mapping-matched range instructions, four per endpoint state, including four descending-as-written cases
manifest.selection: All complete pairs were frozen before tokenizer exposure and checked against every served prior test_set. Each English arm explicitly states membership of the first and second endpoints as written; each Ainglish arm carries the same instruction with exactly one registered endpoint qualifier.
